mn26:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn26:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn26:2.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena āyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ
mn26:2.3: cirassutā no āvuso ānanda bhagavatā sammukhā dhammī kathā
mn26:2.4: sādhu mayaṃ āvuso ānanda labheyyāma bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti.
mn26:2.5: tenahāyasmanto yena rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo tenupasaṅkamatha
mn26:2.6: appevanāma labheyyātha bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti.
mn26:2.7: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
mn26:3.1: atha kho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
mn26:3.2: āyāmānanda yena pubbārāmo migāramātu pāsādo tenupasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyāti.
mn26:3.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
mn26:3.4: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbārāmo migāramātu pāsādo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn26:3.5: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
mn26:3.6: āyāmānanda yena pubbakoṭṭhako tenupasaṅkamissāma gattāni parisiñcitunti.
mn26:3.7: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
mn26:3.8: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbakoṭṭhako tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ
mn26:3.9: pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
mn26:3.10: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn26:3.11: ayaṃ bhante rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo avidūre
mn26:3.14: sādhu bhante bhagavā yena rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn26:4.1: atha kho bhagavā yena rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo tenupasaṅkami.
mn26:4.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assame dhammiyā kathāya sannisinnā honti.
mn26:4.3: atha kho bhagavā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno.
mn26:4.4: atha kho bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭṭesi.
mn26:4.5: vivariṃsu kho te bhikkhū bhagavato dvāraṃ.
mn26:4.6: atha kho bhagavā rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamaṃ pavisitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn26:4.8: kāya nuttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatāti.
mn26:4.9: bhagavantameva kho no bhante ārabbha dhammī kathā vippakatā atha bhagavā anuppattoti.
mn26:4.11: etaṃ kho bhikkhave tumhākaṃ paṭirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ yaṃ tumhe dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdeyyātha.
mn26:4.13: dhammī vā kathā ariyo vā tuṇhībhāvo.
mn26:5.1: dvemā bhikkhave pariyesanā anariyā ca pariyesanā
mn26:5.4: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesati attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaññeva pariyesati attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhammaññeva pariyesati attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaññeva pariyesati attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhammaññeva pariyesati attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:6.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave jātidhammaṃ dāsi dāsaṃ jātidhammaṃ aje ḷakaṃ jātidhammaṃ kukkuṭa sūkaraṃ jātidhammaṃ hatthi gavā ssa vaḷavaṃ jātidhammaṃ jātarūparajataṃ jātidhammaṃ.
mn26:6.4: etthāyaṃ gadhito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:7.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave jarādhammaṃ dāsi dāsaṃ jarādhammaṃ aje ḷakaṃ jarādhammaṃ kukkuṭa sūkaraṃ jarādhammaṃ hatthi gavā ssa vaḷavaṃ jarādhammaṃ jātarūparajataṃ jarādhammaṃ.
mn26:7.4: etthāyaṃ gadhito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:8.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave byādhidhammaṃ dāsi dāsaṃ byādhidhammaṃ aje ḷakaṃ byādhidhammaṃ kukkuṭa sūkaraṃ byādhidhammaṃ hatthi gavā ssa vaḷavaṃ byādhidhammaṃ jātarūparajataṃ byādhidhammaṃ.
mn26:8.4: etthāyaṃ gadhito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:9.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave maraṇadhammaṃ dāsi dāsaṃ maraṇadhammaṃ aje ḷakaṃ maraṇadhammaṃ kukkuṭa sūkaraṃ maraṇadhammaṃ hatthi gavā ssa vaḷavaṃ maraṇadhammaṃ jātarūparajataṃ maraṇadhammaṃ.
mn26:9.4: etthāyaṃ gadhito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:10.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave sokadhammaṃ dāsi dāsaṃ sokadhammaṃ aje ḷakaṃ sokadhammaṃ kukkuṭa sūkaraṃ sokadhammaṃ hatthi gavā ssa vaḷavaṃ sokadhammaṃ jātarūparajataṃ sokadhammaṃ.
mn26:10.4: etthāyaṃ gadhito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:11.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave saṅkilesadhammaṃ dāsi dāsaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ aje ḷakaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ kukkuṭa sūkaraṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ hatthi gavā ssa vaḷavaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ jātarūparajataṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ.
mn26:11.4: etthāyaṃ gadhito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:12.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati.
mn26:13.1: ahampi sudaṃ bhikkhave pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisattova samāno attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesāmi attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaññeva pariyesāmi attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhammaññeva pariyesāmi attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaññeva pariyesāmi attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhammaññeva pariyesāmi attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaññeva pariyesāmi
mn26:13.3: kinnu kho ahaṃ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesāmi attanā jarādhammo samāno … byādhidhammo samāno … maraṇadhammo samāno … sokadhammo samāno … attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaññeva pariyesāmi
mn26:13.4: yannūnāhaṃ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyanti.
mn26:14.1: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave aparena samayena daharova samāno susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rodantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādesvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ
mn26:15.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn26:15.2: icchāmahaṃ āvuso kālāma imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritunti.
mn26:15.3: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave āḷāro kālāmo maṃ etadavoca
mn26:15.5: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti.
mn26:15.6: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ
mn26:15.7: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi theravādañca jānāmi passāmīti ca paṭijānāmi ahañceva aññe ca.
mn26:15.9: na kho āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti
mn26:15.10: addhā āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatīti.
mn26:15.11: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn26:15.12: kittāvatā no āvuso kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn26:15.13: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave āḷāro kālāmo ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn26:15.15: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā mayhaṃpatthi saddhā
mn26:15.16: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi viriyaṃ mayhaṃpatthi viriyaṃ
mn26:15.17: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi sati mayhaṃpatthi sati
mn26:15.18: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi samādhi mayhaṃpatthi samādhi
mn26:15.19: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi paññā mayhaṃpatthi paññā
mn26:15.20: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ āḷāro kālāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti. tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyanti.
mn26:15.21: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā, sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn26:15.22: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn26:15.23: ettāvatā kho āvuso kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn26:15.24: ettāvatā kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikitvā upasampajja pavedemīti.
mn26:15.25: ahampi kho āvuso kālāma ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti.
mn26:15.26: lābhā no āvuso suladdhaṃ no āvuso
mn26:15.27: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma
mn26:15.28: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi
mn26:15.29: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi tamahaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi
mn26:15.30: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi tamahaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi
mn26:15.31: iti yādiso ahaṃ tādiso tvaṃ yādiso tvaṃ tādiso ahaṃ
mn26:15.32: ehidāni āvuso ubho vasantā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmāti.
mn26:15.33: iti kho bhikkhave āḷāro kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attanā samasamaṃ ṭhapeti uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn26:15.35: nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati yāvadeva ākiñcaññāyatanūpapattiyāti.
mn26:15.36: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tamhā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
mn26:16.1: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn26:16.2: icchāmahaṃ āvuso rāma imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritunti.
mn26:16.3: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave uddako rāmaputto maṃ etadavoca
mn26:16.5: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti.
mn26:16.6: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn26:16.7: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattakena lapitalāpanamattakena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi theravādañca pajānāmi passāmīti paṭijānāmi ahañceva aññe ca.
mn26:16.9: na kho rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesi.
mn26:16.10: addhā rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ vihāsīti.
mn26:16.11: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn26:16.12: kittāvatā no āvuso rāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn26:16.13: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave uddako rāmaputto nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn26:16.15: na kho rāmasseva ahosi saddhā mayhaṃpatthi saddhā
mn26:16.20: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyanti.
mn26:16.21: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn26:16.22: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn26:16.23: ettāvatā no āvuso rāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn26:16.24: ettāvatā kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemīti.
mn26:16.25: ahampi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti.
mn26:16.26: lābhā no āvuso suladdhaṃ no āvuso
mn26:16.27: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma
mn26:16.28: iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedeti taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi
mn26:16.29: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedeti
mn26:16.30: iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo aññāsi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo aññāsi
mn26:16.31: iti yādiso rāmo ahosi tādiso tvaṃ yādiso tvaṃ tādiso rāmo ahosi
mn26:16.33: iti kho bhikkhave uddako rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne ca maṃ ṭhapesi uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn26:16.35: nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati yāvadeva nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpapattiyāti.
mn26:16.36: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
mn26:17.1: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno magadhesu anupubbena cārikañcaramāno yena uruvelā senānigamo tadavasariṃ.
mn26:17.2: tatthaddasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ pāsādikañca vanasaṇḍaṃ nadiñca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.
mn26:17.4: ramaṇīyo vata bhūmibhāgo pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo nadī ca sandati setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā samantā ca gocaragāmo
mn26:17.6: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tattheva nisīdiṃ
mn26:18.1: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ attanā jarādhammo samāno … attanā byādhidhammo samāno … attanā maraṇadhammo samāno … attanā sokadhammo samāno … attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ
mn26:18.3: akuppā me vimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
mn26:19.2: adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo
mn26:19.3: ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā
mn26:19.4: ālayarāmāya kho pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppādo
mn26:19.5: idampi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ
mn26:19.6: ahañceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ so mamassa kilamatho sā mamassa vihesāti.
mn26:19.7: apissu maṃ bhikkhave imā anacchariyā gāthā paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā
mn26:19.16: itiha me bhikkhave paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāyāti.
mn26:20.1: atha kho bhikkhave brahmuno sahampatissa mama cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya etadahosi
mn26:20.2: nassati vata bho loko vinassati vata bho loko yatra hi nāma tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāyāti.
mn26:20.3: atha kho bhikkhave brahmā sahampati seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva kho brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.
mn26:20.4: atha kho bhikkhave brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yenāhaṃ tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā maṃ etadavoca
mn26:20.5: desetu me bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ desetu sugato dhammaṃ
mn26:20.6: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti
mn26:21.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesiṃ.
mn26:21.2: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
mn26:21.3: seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggapositāni appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni samodakaṇṭhitāni appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakaṃ accuggamma tiṭṭhanti anuppalittāni udakena
mn26:21.4: evameva kho ahaṃ bhikkhave buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasaṃ satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
mn26:21.5: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave brahmānaṃ sahampatiṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsiṃ
mn26:21.10: atha kho bhikkhave brahmā sahampati katāvakāso khomhi bhagavatā dhammadesanāyāti maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
mn26:22.2: kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
mn26:22.5: ayaṃ kho āḷāro kālāmo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko
mn26:22.6: yannūnāhaṃ āḷārassa kālāmassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
mn26:22.8: atha kho maṃ bhikkhave devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
mn26:22.14: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya khippameva ājāneyyāti.
mn26:23.2: kassa nu kho paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
mn26:23.5: ayaṃ kho uddako rāmaputto paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko
mn26:23.6: yannūnāhaṃ uddakassa rāmaputtassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
mn26:23.8: atha kho maṃ bhikkhave devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
mn26:23.14: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya khippameva ājāneyyāti.
mn26:24.2: kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
mn26:24.5: bahukārā kho me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū ye maṃ padhānapahitattaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu
mn26:24.6: yannūnāhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyanti.
mn26:24.8: kahaṃ nu kho etarahi pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū viharantīti.
mn26:24.9: addasaṃ kho bhikkhave dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena pañcavaggiye bhikkhū bārāṇasiyaṃ viharante isipatane migadāye.
mn26:24.10: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave uruvelāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmiṃ.
mn26:25.1: addasā kho maṃ bhikkhave upako ājīvako antarā ca gayaṃ antarā ca bodhiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannaṃ
mn26:25.3: vippasannāni kho te āvuso indriyāni parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto
mn26:25.4: kaṃsi tvaṃ āvuso uddissa pabbajito ko vā te satthā kassa vā taṃ dhammaṃ rocesīti.
mn26:25.5: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave upakaṃ ājīvakaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
mn26:25.22: yathā kho tvaṃ āvuso paṭijānāsi arahasi anantajinoti.
mn26:25.27: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave so upako huveyyāvusoti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.
mn26:26.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave anupubbena cārikañcaramāno yena bārāṇasī yena isipatanaṃ migadāyo yena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkamiṃ.
mn26:26.2: addasāsuṃ kho maṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū dūratova āgacchantaṃ
mn26:26.4: ayaṃ kho āvuso samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya
mn26:26.5: so neva abhivādetabbo na paccuṭṭhātabbo nāssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ
mn26:26.6: apica kho āsanaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ sace ākaṅkhissati nisīdissatīti.
mn26:26.7: yathā yathā kho ahaṃ bhikkhave upasaṅkamiṃ tathā tathā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu sakāya katikāya saṇṭhātuṃ
mn26:26.8: appekacce maṃ paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesuṃ appekacce āsanaṃ paññāpesuṃ appekacce pādodakaṃ upaṭṭhapesuṃ
mn26:26.9: apica kho maṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.
mn26:27.2: mā bhikkhave tathāgataṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācarittha
mn26:27.4: odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ amatamadhigataṃ ahamanusāsāmi ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi
mn26:27.5: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathāti.
mn26:27.6: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etadavocuṃ
mn26:27.7: tāyapi kho tvaṃ āvuso gotama ariyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamā uttari manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ kiṃ pana tvaṃ etarahi bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttari manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesanti.
mn26:27.8: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ
mn26:27.9: na bhikkhave tathāgato bāhulliko na padhānavibbhanto na āvatto bāhullāya
mn26:27.11: odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ amatamadhigataṃ ahamanusāsāmi ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi
